summary: Import preserves playable Agent meaning with enumerated structural defaults and one standard-skill demotion. Creator workflow state is retained in extensions rather than treated as loss.

losses.loss: GAC models Unarmed Combat as a first-class skill; canonical Agent 1.0.0 has no unarmedCombat standard skill id. Rating is preserved as a custom skill (group unarmed_combat, label Unarmed Combat) instead of skills.standard.
losses.remediation: Accept custom skill, or later amend canonical schema and remap.

losses.loss: Free-text equipment cannot populate weapons, armor, rituals, or tomes without user remapping. Prose that names a weapon remains gear.
losses.remediation: One-import remapping choice (issue #6) may promote specific gear entries later.

losses.loss: GAC has no bond-damage flag. Import always sets damagedSinceLastHomeScene to false.
losses.remediation: Existing-Actor update policy must not overwrite live bond damage without review.

losses.loss: GAC's single bond text field becomes canonical name; canonical relationship and description remain unset. Not semantic loss of the text, but loss of GAC field naming on round-trip to other tools.
losses.remediation: None required for import fidelity of display identity.

losses.loss: GAC motivations are plain strings. crossedOut defaults to false; linkedDisorderId is never auto-set.
losses.remediation: User may mark crossed-out / link disorders after import.

losses.loss: Single disorder string becomes one uncured disorder with no description.
losses.remediation: None required unless Handler marks cured later.

losses.loss: GAC expresses adapted state as free text, not 0–3 incident marks. Import sets adapted=true for recognized or other lines and never invents incidentMarks.
losses.remediation: User may add incident history in Foundry/canonical editors.

losses.loss: Non YYYY-MM-DD dob values cannot populate strict ISO dateOfBirth. Original text is preserved in the extension.
losses.remediation: Later Foundry-import UI may ask for campaign epoch / age; out of scope for this capability.

losses.loss: Creator-local ids are not durable canonical identities. New UUID v4 values are generated for agentId, bonds, motivations, disorders, adaptations, gear, and custom skills.
losses.remediation: Stable Actor binding uses adapter keys on Foundry side (issues #7/#10), not GAC ids.

losses.loss: GAC has no special-training model. Canonical array is empty.
losses.remediation: Add special training after import if needed.

losses.loss: GAC has a single notes string mapped only to notes.player. Handler notes stay empty.
losses.remediation: Handler may add private notes in Foundry.

losses.loss: No structured GAC sources for these collections; they import empty.
losses.remediation: Create Items after import or use one-import remapping from gear prose.

losses.loss: Fields absent from GAC remain unset.
Fields absent from GAC remain unset.
GAC does not model Impossible Landscapes campaign fields.
losses.remediation: Set in Foundry/campaign tools if applicable.

losses.loss: Semantic round-trip compares meaning, not byte equality or regenerated UUIDs. A→canonical→A is not claimed by this capability.
losses.remediation: Export capability would be a separate ticket.

notLosses: Creator workflow fields retained under extensions.greenAgentCreator (workflow, skillConstruction, sheetBaseline, identity).
Explicit derivedCurrent zeros preserved (not treated as missing).
Out-of-range stats/skills warned but not silently clamped.
Profession keys retained in workflow even when biography.profession shows the English label.
